notes: All SQL run by the engine lives here. Intents are what the router (Groq function-calling, or the rule fallback) chooses between.

intents.name: rate_lookup
intents.description: Rates/APR/APY/dividend for loans, mortgages, certificates, savings, checking; tiers, terms, model years, as-of dates, highest/lowest, yes/no on a rate.
examples: What is the APR on a 36-month personal loan?
Do any savings tiers pay 0.35% APY?
What was the 10-month jumbo certificate rate as of May 2026?

intents.name: credit_cards
intents.description: Credit card APRs and which cards Dupaco offers.
examples: What credit cards do you offer and what are their APRs?

intents.name: branch_closure
intents.description: Whether/when a branch closes or has closed.
examples: When does the Hy-Vee branch close?
Is the Asbury branch still open?

intents.name: branch_count
examples: How many branches does Dupaco have?

intents.name: branch_hours
intents.description: Lobby or drive-up hours, general or for a named branch.
examples: Lobby hours for the Platteville branch?

intents.name: branch_address
intents.description: Street address of a named branch.
examples: What is the address of the Galena Branch?

intents.name: link_lookup
intents.description: The URL to use for a task (certificate rates, branch locator, join online).
examples: What link should I use to see CD rates?
How do I join Dupaco online?

intents.name: membership_eligibility
examples: Who is eligible to become a Dupaco member?

intents.name: contact_update
examples: How can I update my contact information?

intents.name: unlisted_rate
intents.description: Rate for a program the site does not price (ARM, construction, HELOC...). Must refuse.
examples: What rate do you charge on a construction loan?

intents.name: general_fact
intents.description: Any other factual question about Dupaco (programs, recognition, wallets, students...). Answered by passage retrieval.
examples: Can I add my card to Apple Pay?

rates_dominant.description: One row per row-key: canonical page first, then newest effective date. {marks} = placeholders for the family list.
rates_dominant.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ckey ORDER BY (rank>1), COALESCE(NULLIF(eff,''),'0000') DESC, rank) AS rn FROM rates r WHERE snap_idx=? AND family IN ({marks}) AND segment=?) WHERE rn=1

rates_corroboration.description: Other pages in the snapshot carrying the identical rate row value (extra sources).
rates_corroboration.sql: SELECT DISTINCT url FROM rates WHERE snap_idx=? AND ckey=? AND rank<=3 AND IFNULL(rate,-1)=IFNULL(?,-1) AND IFNULL(apr,-1)=IFNULL(?,-1) AND IFNULL(apy,-1)=IFNULL(?,-1)

cards_for_snapshot.description: Credit-card APR facts in a snapshot, best authority first.
cards_for_snapshot.sql: SELECT * FROM cards WHERE snap_idx=? ORDER BY rank

routing_votes.description: Chunks mentioning the routing/ABA number, ranked by page authority.
routing_votes.sql: SELECT url, rank, text FROM sent WHERE first_idx<=? AND last_idx>=? AND (text LIKE '%outing number%' OR text LIKE '%ABA%') ORDER BY rank

branch_count_latest.description: Branch-count boilerplate values with page dates (latest dated page wins).
branch_count_latest.sql: SELECT url, pub, value FROM counts WHERE snap_idx=? ORDER BY pub DESC, value DESC

closure_candidates.description: Dated chunks that mention a closing / last day of service.
closure_candidates.sql: SELECT url, rank, pub, text FROM sent WHERE first_idx<=? AND last_idx>=? AND (text LIKE '%clos%' OR text LIKE '%last day%') AND pub!=''

hours_for_snapshot.description: Lobby/drive-up hour blocks in a snapshot.
hours_for_snapshot.sql: SELECT url, title, pub, kind, lines, blurb FROM hours WHERE snap_idx=?

hours_all_snapshots.description: Hour blocks across all snapshots (fallback when the snapshot has none).
hours_all_snapshots.sql: SELECT url, title, pub, kind, lines, blurb FROM hours

hours_place_titles.description: Titles of pages carrying hours blocks (known place names).
hours_place_titles.sql: SELECT blurb, title FROM hours WHERE snap_idx=?

locator_branches.description: Dupaco branch entries (street, city, state, zip, services) from /contact.
locator_branches.sql: SELECT * FROM locator WHERE snap_idx=? AND name LIKE '%Dupaco%'

locator_place_tokens.description: Street/city of every locator entry (known branch names).
locator_place_tokens.sql: SELECT street, city FROM locator WHERE snap_idx=?

links_with_authority.description: Every link in a snapshot with the linking page authority rank.
links_with_authority.sql: SELECT l.url, l.text, l.href, p.rank FROM links l JOIN pages p ON p.snap_idx=l.snap_idx AND p.url=l.url WHERE l.snap_idx=?

membership_eligibility_chunks.description: Join-page chunks that describe who is eligible to become a member.
membership_eligibility_chunks.sql: SELECT id, url, text FROM sent WHERE url LIKE '%/about/join%' AND first_idx<=? AND last_idx>=? AND (text LIKE '%charter area%' OR text LIKE '%immediate family%' OR text LIKE '%Iowa, Illinois and Wisconsin%' OR text LIKE '%You belong to%' OR text LIKE '%keep at least%') ORDER BY id

phone_number_page.description: Canonical page carrying the member-service phone number.
phone_number_page.sql: SELECT url FROM sent WHERE text LIKE '%800-373-7600%' AND rank<=2 AND first_idx<=? AND last_idx>=? LIMIT 1

retrieve_fts.description: BM25 passage retrieval (fallback) restricted to chunks visible in the chosen snapshot.
retrieve_fts.sql: SELECT s.id, s.url, s.rank, s.pub, s.head, s.title, s.text FROM sent_fts f JOIN sent s ON s.id=f.rowid WHERE sent_fts MATCH ? AND s.first_idx<=? AND s.last_idx>=? ORDER BY bm25(sent_fts) LIMIT ?

next_chunk_on_page.description: The chunk that follows a short hit on the same page.
next_chunk_on_page.sql: SELECT text FROM sent WHERE url=? AND id>? AND first_idx<=? AND last_idx>=? ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

warm_fts.description: Warm-up probe so the first answer is not slower than later ones.
warm_fts.sql: SELECT 1 FROM sent_fts WHERE sent_fts MATCH 'rate' LIMIT 1

conflict_rate_rows.description: All rate rows in the snapshot, for conflict detection across pages.
conflict_rate_rows.sql: SELECT * FROM rates WHERE snap_idx=? AND family NOT IN ('other')

conflict_branch_counts.description: All branch-count values in the snapshot, for conflict reporting.
conflict_branch_counts.sql: SELECT value, url, pub FROM counts WHERE snap_idx=? ORDER BY pub DESC

conflict_hours_variants.description: Hour blocks for detecting branch-specific schedule variants.
conflict_hours_variants.sql: SELECT url, kind, lines FROM hours WHERE snap_idx=?
